name: setup_playground_seqs
sql: CREATE TABLE seqs AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('foo', 'AAATATAGATGAGTGTGCTGTGTAGTGATCGTAGTGATCGATGTGATGTGTGAACCACACACCACCACACCGAGCTAGTCTG')) AS t(read_id, sequence1)

name: playground_rype_extract_minimizer_set
sql: SELECT read_id || ' ' || fwd_set::VARCHAR || ' ' || rc_set::VARCHAR FROM rype_extract_minimizer_set('seqs', 64, 10)

name: setup_sequences
sql: CREATE TABLE sequences AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('seq1', 'ACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGT'), ('seq2', 'TGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCA'), ('seq3', 'GGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGG'), ('seq4', 'ACGTTGCAAGGCTTACCGATGCATCGATCGGATCCTAGCTAGGCTAACGTTAGC')) AS t(read_id, sequence1)

name: rype_extract_minimizer_set
sql: SELECT count(*) || ' rows, md5=' || md5(string_agg(read_id || ':' || fwd_set::VARCHAR || '|' || rc_set::VARCHAR, ';' ORDER BY read_id)) FROM rype_extract_minimizer_set('sequences', 32, 10)

name: rype_extract_strand_minimizers
sql: SELECT count(*) || ' rows, md5=' || md5(string_agg(read_id || ':' || fwd_hashes::VARCHAR || '|' || fwd_positions::VARCHAR || '|' || rc_hashes::VARCHAR || '|' || rc_positions::VARCHAR, ';' ORDER BY read_id)) FROM rype_extract_strand_minimizers('sequences', 16, 8)

name: setup_sourcetracker_samples
sql: CREATE TABLE st_samples AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('soil1','source','soil'),('soil2','source','soil'),('gut1','source','gut'),('sink_a','sink',NULL),('sink_b','sink',NULL)) AS t(sample_id, source_sink, env)

name: sourcetracker
sql: SELECT count(*) || ' rows, md5=' || md5(string_agg(sink_id || ':' || source || ':' || proportion::VARCHAR || ':' || proportion_std::VARCHAR || ':' || map_entries(assignments)::VARCHAR, ';' ORDER BY sink_id, source)) FROM sourcetracker('st_counts', 'st_samples', assignments := true, seed := 42, source_rarefaction_depth := 0, sink_rarefaction_depth := 0)
